name: bhuvan-skills
description: Claude Code skills for checking changes before they ship: a pre-commit review (English and French) and a draft-PR workflow with agent reviews and a smoke test.

plugins.name: pre-commit-review
plugins.description: Pre-commit review that judges whether a diff is the right change (scope, contracts, simplicity, intent), not just one that passes CI.

plugins.name: revue
plugins.description: French version of pre-commit-review: judges whether a diff is the right change before committing.

plugins.name: pr-revue-smoke
plugins.description: French PR workflow: open as draft, two sequential subagent reviews (design, then code), a smoke-test subagent, then gh pr ready.
